text: Liaoning Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd. (辽宁海粮农业集团有限公司), the Hailiang company that signed the strategic partnership with Liaoning Tieren, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Hailiang Agriculture Group (per the group's own site). The group's parent, Shanghai Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd. (founded 2023-02, registered capital RMB 2 billion), is a limited-liability company registered as invested in and controlled by natural persons (有限责任公司（自然人投资或控股）); its legal representative is Lu Yiming (卢一铭), and company-registration aggregator Qichamao's shareholders section lists two natural-person shareholders, Lu Yiming and Wang Abing (王阿兵).
short: Hailiang Agriculture is a private grain group held by natural persons Lu Yiming and Wang Abing.
